title: 第十一章  战略级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶落看着眼前这一幕，震惊道：“月姐，这，这是怎么回事？”

沈苍月深吸一口气，“竟然是变异人勾结异域，看来矛盾又激化了，不过不用担心，这只异兽很快就会有人来制裁的。”

“变异人?什么意思？”

“变异人就是在空间门附近原力值大于灵力值遭受腐蚀，变异，基本上和修炼灵力的人一样，但他们更倾向于异域，联邦早就想清除他们了，但是也总有派系反对，认为这对于那些善良的变异人来说就太不公平了。”

远处，一丝金光闪过，沈苍月嘴角一翘，“竟然是她亲自出动。”

——幻影大楼

狰狞的异兽扭头看向身后七彩斑斓的星辰支柱，神情越发狰狞，就是这种柱子连接着诸天大阵，才让他们一直攻不破。

它开始快速蓄积力量，想要一举击碎星辰之柱！

“其实就凭你的力量，就算是轰中了，也不会对其造成什么影响，毕竟这根柱子的材料可是域外星辰钢和域外仙珍铁共同锻铸而成，不要说你，就算是你的老祖宗，也未必能怎么样！”

“还有我劝你最好不要乱动，否则我不保证后果是什么。”

一道轻飘飘的警告声自远方传来了过来。

何穗和战略级异兽同时扭头望过去。

只见一名表情淡漠的金发女子站在不远处的房子废墟上，其身后是一名名肃杀的将军林立着。

看到那名金发的女子，何穗就像见鬼一样，有些失态的大吼道。

“不可能，你怎么可能这么快出现在这里，你不应该在域外战场吗？”

金发女子掩口轻笑，

“很抱歉，今天正好是我的生日，我和别人换班了，我刚好就在这附近。首先恭喜你要晋级S级通缉犯了。但我现在很不高兴，因为你打扰到我的生日了，今晚的闹剧就到此结束。”

金发女子抬起头看向何穗和那只被召唤出来的战略级异兽！

何穗毫不犹豫地转身就跑，丝毫不管那只异兽！

“这里有我就行了，你们救援百姓吧。”

金发女子手一挥。

“是！”

身后士兵，军官全部四散开来！

此时此刻，眼前这只异兽被彻底激怒了，他感觉自己被藐视了。

Page (1/3)

Ye Luo looked at the scene in front of him and said in shock: "Sister Yue, what is going on?"

Shen Cangyue took a deep breath, "It turned out to be a mutant colluding with a foreign land. It seems that the conflict has intensified again, but don't worry, someone will punish this alien beast soon."

"Mutant? What do you mean?"

"Mutants are those whose force value is greater than their spiritual power near the space gate and suffer corrosion and mutation. They are basically the same as those who practice spiritual power, but they are more inclined to foreign lands. The Federation has long wanted to eliminate them, but there are always factions who oppose it, thinking that this is too unfair to those kind-hearted mutants."

In the distance, a golden light flashed, and Shen Cangyue raised the corner of her mouth, "It was actually her who took action herself."

——Phantom Building

The ferocious alien beast turned to look at the colorful star pillars behind it, its expression becoming more ferocious. It was this kind of pillar that connected the formations of the heavens that made them unable to break through.

It began to quickly accumulate strength and wanted to crush the Star Pillar in one fell swoop!

"In fact, with your strength, even if it is hit, it will not have any impact. After all, the material of this pillar is forged from extraterrestrial star steel and extraterrestrial fairy iron. Let alone you, even your ancestors may not be able to do anything!"

"And I advise you not to move, otherwise I can't guarantee what the consequences will be."

A soft warning sound came from the distance.

He Sui and the strategic beast turned to look over at the same time.

I saw a blond woman with an indifferent expression standing on the ruins of a house not far away, and behind her stood a stern general.

Seeing the blond woman, He Sui yelled as if he had seen a ghost.

"Impossible, how could you appear here so quickly? Shouldn't you be on the battlefield outside the territory?"

The blonde woman covered her mouth and chuckled,

"I'm sorry, today happens to be my birthday. I changed shifts with someone else, and I happened to be nearby. First of all, congratulations on being promoted to S-class wanted criminal. But I'm very unhappy now because you disturbed my birthday, and tonight's farce ends here."

The blond woman raised her head and looked at He Sui and the summoned strategic beast!

He Sui turned around and ran away without hesitation, not caring about the strange beast at all!

"As long as I'm here, you can rescue the people."

The blonde woman waved her hand.

"Yes!"

The soldiers and officers behind him all scattered!

At this moment, the strange beast in front of him was completely angered, and he felt that he was being despised.

Obviously, he didn't recognize the blond woman in front of him;
